'''Einar''' was an [[Asha'man]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Einar}}

==Quotes==

"''I'm trying to stop him, but he's in a circle. A full circle. I've never seen such power before''" (About Demandred).

==Activities==
Einar is fighting in the [[Last Battle]] alongside [[Uno Nomesta]] and [[Kwamesa]] Sedai when [[Demandred]] arrives [[Link|linked]] in a [[circle]] of seventy-two. He and the [[Aes Sedai]] are killed by [[balefire]] by the [[Forsaken]]{{ref/book|14|37}}.

== Trivia ==
* Einar is named for Einar Laastad Kjosavik, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
